data.body: [P2] Handle existing Athena tables before advertising the new column. Tables created by an earlier Explorer version still lack `droppedcauses`: `ExplorerSession.onEnsureAthenaTable` returns immediately when the table exists, and `ensureAthenaTable` only issues `CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`. After upgrading, generated queries referencing this newly advertised field therefore fail with `COLUMN_NOT_FOUND`; saving settings cannot fix them. Detect the missing column and provide an `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMNS (droppedcauses boolean)` migration path before treating the table as compatible. Add regression coverage for an existing table with the old schema.
